"""Bounded attribution of live subshape enumeration, without shipping patches."""
from pathlib import Path
from functools import wraps
import hashlib, importlib, inspect, json, os, runpy, sys, time
ROOT = Path('/Users/jakefitzgerald/.codex/worktrees/3c6b/text-to-cad')
WORK = ROOT / 'models/tmp/mono-enumeration-profile-20260910'
SOURCE = ROOT / 'models/tmp/performance-final-mono-20260910/planetary_gear_assembly.py'
OUT = ROOT / 'scripts/bench/cadgen-performance/results/mono-enumeration-profile-20260910.json'
assert not WORK.exists() and not OUT.exists()
WORK.mkdir(parents=True)
os.environ.update(CADGEN_CACHE_DIR=str(WORK / 'store'), CADGEN_DAEMON='0', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'scripts/bench/cadgen-performance'))
import common
from cadgen._internal import op_memo, determinism
from build123d import Shape, Compound, Vertex, Edge, Face, Solid
from build123d.topology import shape_core
before = common.metadata()
source_bytes = SOURCE.read_bytes()
source_stat = SOURCE.stat()
determinism.install(); op_memo.install()
body = runpy.run_path(str(SOURCE), run_name='enumeration_diagnostic')['planetary_gear_assembly'].__wrapped__
# Both normal and measured calls execute the same authored body with warm ops.
body(); body()
originals=[]; active=False; stack=[]; counts={}
def measure(fn, name):
    @wraps(fn)
    def call(*args, **kwargs):
        if not active: return fn(*args, **kwargs)
        t=time.perf_counter(); entry=[0.0]; stack.append(entry)
        try: return fn(*args, **kwargs)
        finally:
            elapsed=time.perf_counter()-t; stack.pop()
            if stack: stack[-1][0]+=elapsed
            row=counts.setdefault(name, {'calls':0,'inclusiveMs':0.0,'selfMs':0.0})
            row['calls']+=1; row['inclusiveMs']+=elapsed*1000; row['selfMs']+=(elapsed-entry[0])*1000
    return call
for owner, name in [(shape_core,'_topods_entities'),(Shape,'get_shape_list'),(Compound,'cast'),
                    (Shape,'__init__'),(Vertex,'__init__'),(Edge,'__init__'),(Face,'__init__'),(Solid,'__init__'),
                    (op_memo,'_signature_hash'),(op_memo,'_signature')]:
    raw=inspect.getattr_static(owner,name)
    originals.append((owner,name,raw))
    label=f'{getattr(owner,"__name__",type(owner).__name__)}.{name}'
    if isinstance(raw, staticmethod): wrapped=staticmethod(measure(raw.__func__,label))
    elif isinstance(raw, classmethod): wrapped=classmethod(measure(raw.__func__,label))
    else: wrapped=measure(raw,label)
    setattr(owner,name,wrapped)
rows=[]
try:
    for i in range(3):
        counts={}; active=True; t=time.perf_counter()
        try: shape=body()
        finally: elapsed=(time.perf_counter()-t)*1000; active=False
        rows.append({'sample':i,'profiledBodyMs':elapsed,'counters':counts,
                     'brepSha256':hashlib.sha256(op_memo._write_brep(shape.wrapped)).hexdigest()})
finally:
    for owner,name,raw in reversed(originals): setattr(owner,name,raw)
assert len({r['brepSha256'] for r in rows})==1
assert SOURCE.read_bytes()==source_bytes and SOURCE.stat().st_mtime_ns==source_stat.st_mtime_ns
assert common.source_fingerprint()==before['sourceFingerprint']
OUT.write_text(json.dumps({'metadata':before,'qualification':'Three profiled unchanged body calls after two warmup calls, bypassing build/publication. Only subshape enumeration/constructors/identity methods instrumented. Nested counters are not additive and instrumentation affects latency. No claim about whole builds or unseen edits.',
    'rows':rows,'sourcesUnchanged':True,'runtimeUnchanged':True,'allBrepDigestsEqual':True,
    'helperSource':Path(__file__).read_text(),'helperSha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()},indent=2)+'\n')
print(OUT)
